projectDescription: A TypeScript monorepo template for backtest-kit that runs crypto trading strategy backtests across 9 symbols in parallel within a single Node process, using a zero-import DI runtime, MongoDB for persistence, and Redis for O(1) candle lookups.
keyFeatures: 6300× real-time aggregate backtesting speed across 9 symbols in a single Node process
Zero-import DI runtime — strategy files access globalThis.core without any import statements
Atomic upserts via findOneAndUpdate with upsert:true — no read-modify-write cycles under concurrent symbol writes
Redis O(1) lookup cache via BaseMap with configurable TTL before falling back to MongoDB
Per-subsystem persistence adapter switching between Live (Mongo) and Backtest (memory/local file) modes
npm workspaces monorepo with Rollup builds producing CJS bundles and rolled-up .d.ts type files
Telegram Scraper + Parser pipeline for ingesting trading signals from channels
ccxt-based exchange integration with Binance spot market candle fetching and order book support
Ladder-averaging strategy pattern with configurable step cost, max steps, and PnL-based close triggers
Mode A (parallel, --entry flag) and Mode B (single-symbol CLI) run modes in the same binary
publicApiSurface: ioc — globalThis.core IoC container with all registered services
BaseCRUD(Model) — factory for Mongoose-backed CRUD: create, update, findById, findByFilter, findAll, iterate, paginate
BaseMap(connectionKey, ttlExpireSeconds) — Redis-backed map: get, set, delete, has, clear, toArray, iterate, keys, values, size
provide(symbol, factory) / inject<T>(symbol) / init() — DI primitives from di-kit via createActivator('pro')
LoggerService — log, debug, info, warn, setLogger
ScraperService.scrapeDay(channel, date) — fetch Telegram channel messages for a day
ParserService.parseDay(messages, format) — extract structured fields from raw messages via regex format
CryptoYodaScreenService.screenDay(date) / parseDay(scraperList) — combined scrape+parse for crypto_yoda_channel
CandleDbService.create(dto) / hasCandle(symbol, interval, timestamp) / findBySymbolIntervalTimestamp(...) — atomic candle upserts
addStrategySchema({ strategyName, getSignal }) — register a trading strategy
addExchangeSchema({ exchangeName, getCandles, getOrderBook, getAggregatedTrades, formatPrice, formatQuantity }) — register an exchange
addFrameSchema({ frameName, interval, startDate, endDate }) — register a backtest time frame
Backtest.background(symbol, { exchangeName, strategyName, frameName }) — start a background backtest for one symbol
Live.background(symbol, { exchangeName, strategyName }) — start a background live/paper trade for one symbol
listenActivePing(handler) — subscribe to per-tick backtest events
cacheCandles({ exchangeName, from, to, interval, symbol }) — pre-warm candle cache into MongoDB
CC_SYMBOL_LIST, CC_MONGO_CONNECTION_STRING, CC_REDIS_HOST, CC_REDIS_PORT, CC_REDIS_USER, CC_REDIS_PASSWORD — environment variables
